findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Use of eval or exec
 * @description Detects use of eval or exec which can lead to code injection if used with untrusted input.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/requests-eval-exec-usage
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of eval/exec may lead to code injection if used with untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: requests uses eval/exec, which could enable code injection in some contexts.

message.text: Use of eval/exec may lead to code injection if used with untrusted input.
